_note: Curated GGUF models for the managed llama.cpp runtime. hf_repo/filename/size verified against the HuggingFace API (model-catalog-verify workflow). All entries download anonymously (bartowski GGUF re-uploads). quant is Q4_K_M throughout. min_ram_gb = system RAM for CPU; min_vram_gb = VRAM to fully offload on GPU. Keep this all-open + mostly-permissive; gated/heavily-restricted models are excluded so the dep-free download just works.

models.name: Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct
models.note: Ultra-light and fastest here; runs on almost anything. Great for quick drafts and classification, too small for hard reasoning.

models.name: Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct
models.note: Under 1 GB but noticeably more capable than 0.5B. eVi's zero-config starter — a solid everyday assistant on light hardware.

models.name: Qwen2.5 3B Instruct
models.note: Strong general chat for modest hardware. NOTE: non-commercial Qwen Research License — fine for personal use, check terms for commercial.

models.name: Qwen2.5 7B Instruct
models.note: The local sweet spot — strong all-round quality, runs well on CPU or a mid-range GPU.

models.name: Qwen2.5 14B Instruct
models.note: Sharper reasoning and instruction-following than 7B. Pick it when you have the RAM/VRAM headroom.

models.name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
models.note: Tiny and very fast on CPU with minimal RAM. Good for quick chat and summarization; a Llama-family alternative to Qwen 0.5/1.5B.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
models.note: Balanced everyday pick on modest CPU or a low-VRAM GPU; the Llama-family counterpart to Qwen2.5 3B.

models.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 7B Instruct
models.note: Code-specialized 7B — strong at generation, completion and multi-language reasoning. Best local coding assistant here.
